changedBehavior: App-themed custom title bar with existing build identity and shared appearance flyout, native caption controls, DPI-aware caption insets and a passthrough hit region for the keyboard-accessible appearance button.
expectedAssertions: The title-bar appearance shortcut opens with pointer and keyboard input and updates the existing saved mode without changing palette pairing or backdrop.
Header identity and appearance control are contained in the window and do not overlap the shared scan header or native caption hit targets in restored, maximized and narrow windows.
Light, dark and high-contrast captures retain readable header content and Windows-managed caption controls.
Noninteractive header hit testing retains dragging and maximize/restore while the appearance button receives client input; existing scan headers and navigation remain reachable with enlarged text.
